name: Unilever Brand Key
diagnostic: What foundational root strengths and underlying human insights give the brand the commercial authority to claim its core discriminator?
artifact: The 9-Element Brand Key Blueprint: Root Strength → Competitive Environment → Target Audience → Human Insight → Benefits (Functional & Emotional) → Values & Personality → Reasons to Believe (RTB) → Discriminator → Brand Essence.
trap: Writing the Human Insight as an obvious functional observation instead of the underlying psychological tension.
pedigreeFull: Unilever Global Marketing Practice (developed c. 1995). A standardized model deployed across multinational consumer brands to maintain strategic discipline across global agency rosters.
artifactFull: The 9-Element Brand Key Blueprint: Root Strength → Competitive Environment → Target Audience → Human Insight → Benefits (Functional & Emotional) → Values & Personality → Reasons to Believe (RTB) → Discriminator → Brand Essence.
trapFull: Formulating the "Human Insight" as an obvious functional observation (e.g., "developers want faster builds") rather than uncovering the underlying psychological tension.
